name: Browser
description: A web browser in the desktop app's tabs, next to your notes: containers for several accounts side by side, Shields against ads and trackers, Chrome extensions, history and bookmarks, and agents working beside you. Links in notes and terminals open there, or in another browser with ⌘.
forAgents: A web page for you, beside the user's: `vau browser open <url>` (`vau docs web-viewer`).

openLinks.label: Open web links
openLinks.description: where web links clicked in notes and terminals open in the desktop app: a tab of the viewer (⌘-click: the browser), or always the browser

search.label: Search with
search.description: where words typed in the address go, %s being the words

notifications.label: Notifications from pages
notifications.description: a page's notifications (a new message), and Claude Code on the web's sessions finishing or waiting for you, reach you through the Inbox: a toast, the Mac's notification while the app isn't in front, and a click opens its tab; false drops them

logins.label: Logins
logins.description: whether each workspace's pages have logins of their own (a different account per workspace for the same site; the first workspace keeps the logins pages had before) or every page shares one; pages already open keep theirs until reopened

shields.label: Shields
shields.description: block ads (YouTube's video ads too), trackers and malware sites in web pages, with uBlock Origin's default lists (updated daily); a page's Shields button shows how many requests were blocked on it

shieldsDown.label: Sites with Shields down
shieldsDown.description: sites where nothing is blocked, like example.com (a site's subdomains too); a page's Shields menu adds and removes its site

playerFullScreen.label: Players open full screen
playerFullScreen.description: a page opened as a player (to watch it, or share its window in a call) fills a Space of its own in full screen; off: a window of its own

hide.label: Parts of sites hidden
hide.description: ready-made rules turned on in a page's Shields menu, by name: youtube-shorts (Shorts), youtube-recommendations (the home feed, Up next and end screens), youtube-comments; your own are the Blocked elements note
